findings.claim: staged gate fails open on git error: the git diff --cached catch swallows any failure and treats it as nothing-staged, passing the gate (lanes 4/6/7 proved it live without git on PATH)
doctor certifies uncommitted wiring: checks named committed read the working tree only, so untracked hooks and uncommitted CI edits pass (lanes 3/5/6/8 caught it live against this very commit)
CI=true environment flag flips the doctor hooks-activation check to pass: client-set env used as an authenticity signal
push-base is vacuous-rangeable: --base HEAD audits HEAD..HEAD and exits 0 claiming coverage; doctor checks non-null only, never resolvability or a non-empty range
staged gate binds nothing: any record ever at executing (including done, forever) authorizes all staged code; pass message claims a task-code relationship that was never checked
wiring detectors are raw substring matches: comments, TODOs, and if:false steps satisfy hasCoverageStep/prePushWired
approve remedy misleads: grep ^## output pasted verbatim is refused because the matcher strips the prefix; neither reason nor fix says to strip it
law-enforcement drift: TASK-LIFECYCLE.md teaches docs-only/experiment but tools enforce harness-docs-only/product-protocol (private-repo vocabulary surviving in code constants)
checkRange remedy says advance to executing directly, a command the same tool refuses (illegal jump); must be the two-step chain
footerless-commit remedy names git commit --amend for every flagged sha, but amend only reaches HEAD; deeper commits need a rebase or drop
two independent checklist parsers (doctor regex vs runner lanesFromChecklist) can drift; doctor should delegate to the enforcement parser
doctor hooksPath check is value-blind: any configured directory passes, even one with no stallion hooks
WIRING.md at b702f0c still documents the old fail-open first-push recipe, neutralizing the new fail-closed base resolution for anyone wiring per the committed docs
resolve/wont-fix accept semantically empty evidence: any existing file resolves a CRITICAL finding; any non-empty string justifies a wont-fix
findings.justification: the machine verifies existence and shape; the truth of evidence is judged in review and preserved by git history — the register is accountability, not proof. Binding content (hashing pin-run output into records) is registered future work.

findings.claim: red-check evidence is existence-only: any file satisfies the verifier; the pin itself is unproven by the machine
findings.justification: same boundary class as f14: RED evidence is existence-checked, and the demonstration lives in the session record and commit history. Machine-verifiable pins (failing command plus captured output) are registered future work.

findings.claim: pull_request events are not fenced by the CI coverage step (if push only) while the doctor stays green
resolve enriches unknown-finding errors by sniffing a message prefix from another module; wording drift silently drops the fix hint
classifier sanity check is self-satisfying in the canonical repo (the doctor classifies its own file), incapable of failing at home
findings.justification: the classifier check targets adopting repos whose code lives outside the vendored tools tree; in the canonical repo it is self-satisfied by construction, which is acceptable — every adopter runs it against their own layout.

findings.claim: README does not mention the staged gate, the doctor, or the AGENTS.md adoption surface

--base=rev equals form is silently unparsed in task-coverage argv and --base --staged is swallowed, so the audit can run on a range the operator did not choose (recorded via --claim= because the strict parser refuses dash-leading values)
